company.name: spotLESS Materials
company.shortDescription: spotLESS Materials is a cleantech platform.
company.description: spotLESS Materials engineers nature-inspired, ultra-repellent coatings that prevent fouling from liquids, sludge, bacteria, and mineral deposits. Their flagship technology, LESS (Liquid-Entrenched Smooth Surface), was originally developed to address sanitation challenges in low-water toilets. Inspired by the slippery surfaces of pitcher plants, LESS forms a molecularly smooth, liquid-infused barrier that significantly reduces the need for water, chemicals, and manual cleaning.

aiResearchSummary.text: spotLESS Materials is researching formulations and processes to generate repellent surfaces on medical devices and other substrates. Titles such as formulations and processes to generate repellent surfaces on medical devices, repellent coating formulation with low volatile organic compounds, and repellent coatings for high temperature surfaces describe bonded silane or siloxane layers combined with lubricants to yield low VOC, thermally stable, liquid repellent coatings. Their work spans medical, general, and high temperature repellent surfaces.
